name: omp-builder
description: Self-hosted web application builder powered exclusively by Oh My Pi

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @omp-builder/shared && npm run build --workspace @omp-builder/api && npm run build --workspace @omp-builder/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @omp-builder/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:security: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=2560 npm run build && node tests/security-regression.mjs
